findings.issue: Thread capability: parent_id exists in messages table (FK to self) but no thread metadata, participant tracking, reply count, or unread count
findings.impact: Threaded conversations require schema expansion: thread_metadata table, thread_participants table, thread_last_read tracking
findings.fix: Status: PARTIAL. Add thread_metadata (reply_count, participant_count, last_activity_at), thread_participants, thread_last_read tables

findings.issue: Notifications: basic CRUD + push exists, but NO @mention parsing, @role/@everyone, channel muting, or notification preferences
findings.impact: Mention system is greenfield; notification engine needs rewrite for mention routing
findings.fix: Status: PARTIAL. Add mention parsing pipeline, mention validation against membership, notification preference model per user

findings.issue: Virtualization: NO virtual list, NO inverted scroll, NO windowing — all messages rendered as flat DOM
findings.impact: Channels with 1000+ messages cause OOM; no infinite scroll capability
findings.fix: Status: ABSENT. Must implement from scratch with @tanstack/react-virtual, inverted scroll, cursor pagination

findings.issue: Rich text editor: plain textarea with NO markdown preview, NO @mention autocomplete, NO emoji picker, NO drag-drop
findings.impact: Message input needs complete rewrite for rich editing
findings.fix: Status: ABSENT. Must enhance textarea with mention autocomplete, emoji picker, drag-drop upload, markdown preview

findings.issue: RBAC: owner/admin/member roles exist but NO channel-level overrides, NO custom roles, NO hidden channel support
findings.impact: Granular RBAC requires schema + middleware + RLS redesign
findings.fix: Status: PARTIAL. Add channel_role_overrides table, update middleware for override resolution, design RLS for hidden channels

findings.issue: Search: full-text search exists with search_messages RPC but NO date range filter, NO file metadata search, NO relevance ranking
findings.impact: Search is functional but basic — lacks enterprise search capabilities
findings.fix: Status: PARTIAL. Add ts_rank for relevance scoring, date range filter, file metadata indexing

findings.issue: Incoming webhooks: NONE exist — only outgoing webhook delivery pipeline
findings.impact: External systems cannot post to channels; greenfield feature
findings.fix: Status: ABSENT. Design incoming webhook model with channel ownership, secret generation, payload formatting, rate limiting

findings.issue: Optimistic UI: NO optimistic state system — all mutations wait for API response
findings.impact: UI feels slow; no instant-feedback pattern
findings.fix: Status: ABSENT. Create optimistic state management with temporary IDs, rollback on failure, server-echo deduplication

findings.issue: Multi-theme: light/dark only — NO slate dark, OLED high-contrast, or multi-theme architecture
findings.impact: Theme engine needs expansion for 4 named themes with SSR-safe hydration
findings.fix: Status: PARTIAL. Expand CSS token system; implement SSR-safe theme hydration; add Slate Dark and OLED themes

findings.issue: Audio/video media: NO WebRTC, NO media server, NO signaling channel, NO media grid — greenfield
findings.impact: Audio/video is last priority in roadmap but requires new infrastructure
findings.fix: Status: ABSENT. Phase 3: evaluate LiveKit; design signaling; implement media grid
